mapper.insert: INSERT INTO party_training (training_name, term, start_date, end_date, days, hours, location, organizer, quota, status, content, note, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{trainingName}, #{term}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{days}, #{hours}, #{location}, #{organizer}, #{quota}, #{status}, #{content}, #{note}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM party_training t WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0

SELECT FROM party_training t WHERE t.deleted = 0
ORDER BY t.start_date DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

mapper.update: UPDATE party_training SET training_name = #{training.trainingName}, term = #{training.term}, start_date = #{training.startDate}, end_date = #{training.endDate}, days = #{training.days}, hours = #{training.hours}, location = #{training.location}, organizer = #{training.organizer}, quota = #{training.quota}, status = #{training.status}, content = #{training.content}, note = #{training.note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{training.id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM party_training_member m WHERE m.training_id = #{trainingId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status IN ('signed', 'approved', 'completed')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM party_training_member m WHERE m.training_id = #{trainingId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 'completed'
SELECT t.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM party_training t WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.status ORDER BY t.status
